about.title: Hi, I'm oF.
about.subtitle: Full-Stack Engineer | Knowledge Graphs & Language Model Applications
about.content:
I hold a master’s degree in Information Management and have over one year of experience in full-stack development. I have worked on manufacturing information display systems, e-paper and IoT applications, and fall detection systems.
Beyond system development, I have conducted research and practical work involving knowledge graphs, graph neural networks, and language models, with applications in recommender systems and sentiment and semantic analysis. My experience includes data processing, model training, experimental validation, full-stack development, database integration, and hardware–software integration.

items.title: Knowledge Graph Recommendation
items.description: Research focused on integrating users’ evolving preferences, sentiment-related semantic features from reviews, and product attribute relationships. An attention mechanism was used to combine these features into a personalized recommendation approach.

items.title: Point-of-Interest Recommendation
items.description: Contributed to research combining graph neural networks with sentiment and semantic analysis, including experiment replication, evaluation refinement, data validation, and ablation studies.

items.title: Fall Detection System
items.description: Developed a system that uses human pose estimation and temporal models to distinguish normal activity, loss of balance, and falls, while integrating real-time video, event notifications, and environmental sensing.

highlights: Contributed to the development of e-paper device management and IoT systems.
Worked on front-end and back-end features, database integration, and device communication.
Contributed to manufacturing information displays and management systems.
Developed system features, back-end APIs, database integrations, and analytical reports.

items.topic: A Recommendation Method Based on a Knowledge Graph Integrating Users’ Dynamic Preferences and Sentiment Semantic Features
items.description: Explored personalized recommendation methods by combining users’ evolving preferences, sentiment semantics from reviews, and product knowledge graphs.

items.degree: Department of Information and Communication Engineering | B.S.
items.description: Built a fall detection system integrating human pose estimation, temporal analysis, real-time monitoring, and IoT devices. The project received an Honorable Mention in the department’s 2023 capstone competition.
